scope: Three-risk adversarial review of level5 bridge. Synthetic counterexamples only; no financial experiments.

counterexamples.title: Declared positive curve without replay
counterexamples.mutation: Replace the submitted SVR session curve with +0.2% every day, keep the original orders, snapshots and model; recompute all public artifact hashes.
counterexamples.expected: Gate derives curves from reexecuted coordinator output or blocks; caller-supplied profitability cannot affect score.

counterexamples.title: Stress changes predictive policy
counterexamples.mutation: Use different SVR weights, feature receipt, signal events or risk threshold only in stress while declaring the same scenario id; recompute submitted hashes.
counterexamples.expected: Cross-request comparison rejects any change except explicitly permitted cost multipliers/scenario identity/registration; same original model bytes and signal inputs remain bound.

counterexamples.title: Legacy schema shortcut
counterexamples.mutation: Invoke legacy economic gate schema or dispatcher branch directly with a favorable declared report.
counterexamples.expected: Legacy diagnostic cannot certify level5 or circumvent replay plus all grade5 blockers.

counterexamples.title: Intraday drawdown disappears at daily close
counterexamples.expected: Daily return aggregation preserves 40% drawdown from all event marks and rejects a lower limit.

counterexamples.title: Intraday exposure disappears at daily close
counterexamples.expected: Exposure and funded-cash checks inspect all event snapshots, not only final daily exposure.

counterexamples.title: Fees or operations costs vanish across empty days
counterexamples.mutation: Include a day with no fills but a fixed applicable cost, then compare compacted session rows; include multiple fee-bearing events before the same close.
counterexamples.expected: Session PnL reconciles all original fees and costs; unknown/missing cost coverage blocks. Terminal lump-sum timing remains an explicit model and cannot erase a known intermediate obligation.

counterexamples.title: Coherent rehash of false freshness
counterexamples.mutation: Use a previously inspected final period but set first_final_data_access_at after registration and prior_final_test_uses=[]; rehash manifests.
counterexamples.expected: Read retained source journals/holdouts; known overlap rejects, unavailable global history yields null plus blocker. Local declarations do not become verified freshness.

counterexamples.title: False model and implementation provenance
counterexamples.mutation: Change fitted coefficients after inspecting the test; label model OBSERVED with the accepted panel hash and an earlier available_at; supply arbitrary well-formed 64hex code_hash.
counterexamples.expected: Actual executed-source hash is derived and bound; panel metadata alone cannot validate fitted-model chronology. Training provenance unresolved remains a blocker.

counterexamples.title: CASH benchmark funded by implicit external credit
counterexamples.mutation: Fully invest broker cash then charge external economic costs while no spendable cash remains; declare costs paid outside the account and no capital flows.
counterexamples.expected: Account-only equity and economic funded equity remain distinct; funding of external costs must be explicit and supported. No negative economic cash or unrecorded added capital can silently preserve admissibility.
